# gyro_subnet (Resource)

A subnet of a gyro_vpc (free). /20 to /28 inside the VPC range; .1 is the gateway, .0-.4 and the last address are reserved. Default limit: 4 subnets per VPC (the one created with the VPC included; up to 8 with a support ticket). Every attribute is ForceNew. Destroy needs the subnet to be empty (no gyro_server_nic in it).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A subnet with a fixed range
resource "gyro_subnet" "app" {
  vpc_id = gyro_vpc.uretim.id
  name   = "app"
  cidr   = "10.10.1.0/24"
}

# Let the API pick a free /26 inside the VPC
resource "gyro_subnet" "db" {
  vpc_id = gyro_vpc.uretim.id
  name   = "db"
  prefix = 26
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Subnet name, unique in the VPC.
- `vpc_id` (String) gyro_vpc id.

### Optional

- `cidr` (String) Subnet range inside the VPC, e.g. 10.10.1.0/24. Leave it out to let the API pick a free range of size prefix.
- `prefix` (Number) Size of the automatically picked range when cidr is not set (20-28, API default 24).

### Read-Only

- `capacity` (Number) Usable addresses for servers.
- `gateway_ip` (String) Gateway address of the subnet (.1).
- `id` (String) <vpc_id>/<subnet_id>
- `subnet_id` (String) Subnet id (use it in gyro_server_nic.subnet_id).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import gyro_subnet.app 12/34
```
